messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw a ~3x spike in 413s for /v1/embeddings on canary starting ~10:02 UTC. Most are oversize payloads but a subset show normal byte size + weird dims header.

jason: ugh. any sample ids? can you paste a minimal log line?

maria: pasted a couple. we redact actual user text but keep dims + content-length. log snippet: `INGRESS 10:02:13 tenant=acme svc=embed route=/v1/embeds status=413 content-length=8192 X-Embed-Dims=1536 payload-frames=1`

ali: hmm X-Embed-Dims=1536 with content-length 8k shouldn't 413 unless framing mismatch. maybe client sent base64 or newline noise?

sara: also seeing a cluster of 413s where `payload-frames>1` but header dims=1024. splitter currently assumes dims header implies single-frame vector payload. mismatch => runtime rejects.

kevin: ok two issues: (1) legit oversize payloads (need quota/reject UX) (2) header mismatch causing false positives — we should sample full payloads for debugging. but privacy + retention are concerns.

maria: propose: add an "ingress-error-sampler" that will capture full request body for 1% of 413s and attach a short trace id. store for 7 days in a secured bucket with KMS encryption. We surface in dashboard only for infra investigators. Thoughts?

jason: +1 for sampling, but 1% might be noisy for high-volume tenants. can we sample per-tenant up to N/day and per-route global cap? e.g., max 10 samples/tenant/day, global 200/day.

ali: agree per-tenant cap. Also need to add opt-out header for customers with PII concerns: `X-Embed-Debug: disabled` or auto-respect `Do-Not-Store` flag.

sara: we should also add structured telemetry metric: `embed.ingress.413_samples_total{reason=mismatch|oversize, sampler=on/off}` and a histogram for content-length when 413 occurs. That helps put error budget on the dashboard.

kevin: dashboard design: new panel "413 error budget" showing: error-rate over time, sampled payloads count, top dims seen in 413s, top tenants, and a retention slider for investigators. We should add a link-per-sample to a secure viewer (audit-logged).

maria: rollout plan: (a) add sampler behind feature flag (console toggle per-org), (b) default sample rates: 1% global, tenant cap 10/day, global cap 200/day, (c) run for 2 weeks on canary then staged fleets.

jason: one more: preflight should catch dim/payload frame mismatches before forwarding. Add a fast-fail with clearer error body (`{"error":"DIM_FRAME_MISMATCH","expected_frames":1}`) to avoid opaque 413. This reduces noise and gives clients actionable fix.

ali: agree. also update client SDKs to compute expected bytes from dims and warn client before send. We can add a console console-hint in the error suggesting `X-Embed-Dims` correction.

sara: note for telemetry retention: sampled full payloads must be excluded from normal analytics exports to avoid leakage into billing/reporting. Mark with `sensitive:true` tag.

kevin: sounds good. action items: maria add PR for sampler + storage infra, jason update preflight fast-fail messages, ali update SDK warning patch, sara add dashboard panels and metrics, i'll draft console toggle UX copy and perms.

maria: filing runbook and a tiny alert: `embed.ingress.413_rate > 1% for 10m` triggers a pager to eng-platform oncall and posts sample link in private channel. I'll drop the PR link when ready. :thumbsup:

ingress-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for feature-flag "ingress-error-sampler" to 5% traffic.

maria: deployed canary, will watch for noisy sampling. will report back with numbers in ~24h.
